notes.title: Version 1.0.0.8
notes.content:
- Improved performance of ice and fire skills
- Improved arrow particles performance
- Usability fixes for NPC controls
- New difficulty: "Easy"
- Improved health-scaling rings

notes.title: Version 1.0.0.7
notes.content:
Small performance improvements.
Fixed the Achievment "Opened the Seal"

notes.title: Update 1.0.0.6
notes.content:
- Fixes on joystick compatibility.
- Better navigation on UI using joystick.

notes.title: Version 1.0.0.5
notes.content:
- vendor bug fixes
- damage calculation adjustments (now skills has more value)
- added "in combat" alert

notes.title: Update 1.0.0.4
notes.content:
- Axe adjustments (more damage based on health, less attack speed and base damage).
- Bug fixes.

notes.title: Update 1.0.0.3
notes.content:
Bug fixes for potions and the defender ring.
Improved clarity in the scythe ritual.
General improvements to shield rings.
Vendors now leave after selling all their items.

notes.title: Update 1.0.0.2
notes.content:
Another round of game balance improvements based on player feedback:

Final Boss Combat Adjustments: More precise action windows.
Bug Fix for Fire Staff: Now deals the expected damage when casting the fire explosion on contact with a target.
Fire Staff buffs:
- Fire Explosion: damage increased from 130% to 140%.
- Meteor: damage increased from 270% to 290%.
Edge of Night nerf:
- Basic Attack: damage reduced from 30% to 28%.
Igraine's Ring nerf:
- Healing adjusted from 1+(level/5) to 1+(level/6).

notes.title: Update 1.0.0.1
notes.content:
In the 1.0.0.1 update, we made some improvements based on feedback from players on the first day:

Nerfed the axe.
Added an option to skip the introduction.
Displayed door codes (to match the corresponding keys).
Adjusted attribute description texts.
Have a great journey in the Tomb of Doznath!
